create_metric_descriptor: create a MetricDescriptor dataclass with name, display_name, priority, and formatter fields
create_metric_formatter: create a MetricFormatter protocol callable that formats a metric value into a string
use_noop_descriptor: use the NOOP_METRIC_DESCRIPTOR constant as a default no-op metric descriptor
create_metric_descriptor_registry: create a MetricDescriptorRegistry from an iterable of MetricDescriptor instances
lookup_metric_descriptor: lookup a MetricDescriptor by name using the registry maybe_get method
